Noida Airport Waterlogged After Heavy Rain, Opposition Criticizes Authorities

The newly inaugurated Noida International Airport experienced significant waterlogging following heavy rainfall. Opposition leader Akhilesh Yadav criticized the government, questioning the airport's preparedness and suggesting boats might be needed. Authorities described the waterlogging as a temporary issue, attributing it to the intense rain.
